name: continuum-app-web
description: Plateforme Fonctionnelle — front Angular (continuum-app-web). Client API généré depuis les contrats (D32).

scripts.generate:missions: redocly bundle ../Instructions/contracts/openapi/app/missions.yaml -o libs/.contracts/missions.bundled.yaml && openapi-generator-cli generate -i libs/.contracts/missions.bundled.yaml -g typescript-angular -o libs/api-clients/missions --additional-properties=ngVersion=19.0.0,supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true
scripts.generate:findings: redocly bundle ../Instructions/contracts/openapi/app/findings.yaml -o libs/.contracts/findings.bundled.yaml && openapi-generator-cli generate -i libs/.contracts/findings.bundled.yaml -g typescript-angular -o libs/api-clients/findings --additional-properties=ngVersion=19.0.0,supportsES6=true,withInterfaces=true
